title: Warm Flaky American Turkey Flatbread
description: A fermented, flaky, monsoon American dish featuring turkey, caramelized onions, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a cozy dinner
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine warm water, yeast, and sugar, and let it sit for 5 minutes until the yeast is activated
Add flour, salt, and 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the bowl, and mix until a dough forms
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour until it is doubled in size
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Roll out the dough into a large rectangle, and place it on a baking sheet
Arrange the sliced turkey and caramelized onions on one half of the dough
Fold the other half of the dough over the filling, and brush with the remaining olive oil
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 20 minutes until it is golden brown
Let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
